title: Replace diff-render freeze hashes with a deterministic structural input fingerprint shared by the helper and launcher
outcome: The helper and launcher identify the same frozen input with one versioned structural fingerprint, preserving exact HEAD/root binding, independent staged-content identity (the index tree id, taken from a temporary copy of the index), and actual worktree paths/types/modes/bytes including admitted untracked content. Its identity does not depend on rendered Git diffs. Required distinctions currently detected by status are retained structurally. The old diff-render identity is replaced in active capture/verification consumers; historical records keep their original meaning and are not promoted to new evidence. The existing independent Engram review-freeze protocol is not silently reinterpreted.
acceptance: One canonical freeze key: the Git tree id of the frozen content, printed by both the freeze script and the launcher is done
